description: Open-Meteo's CAMS air-quality model for eight cities: hourly fine particles (PM2.5) for the past three days and the next two, against the WHO 24-hour guideline (15 µg/m³), and daily means of PM2.5, PM10, NO₂ and ozone. Statistics: the guideline is a 99th percentile (no more than 3–4 days a year above it), so the second graph shows each city's distribution of hours as quantiles and counts the days whose mean exceeds 15. Modelled values, not station measurements; five days are a small sample of a year.
name: Air quality in eight cities
